boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten recurring Sacred Heart University traditions documented by University Student Involvement and orientation materials.

cards.title: Start the semester at the Just SHU It Fair
cards.subtitle: Sacred Heart University, Fairfield, CT
cards.notes: Go during the first week of a semester to meet student-run clubs and organizations, compare their activities and choose which groups to contact.
cards.short_summary: A semester-opening club and organization fair for undergraduate students.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart says the Just SHU It Fair occurs during the first week of each semester and helps undergraduates join its student-run clubs and organizations.
cards.access_notes: Timing is the first week of each semester; consult Student Involvement for the current event details.

cards.title: Dress up for the President's Gala
cards.subtitle: Sacred Heart University, Fairfield, CT
cards.notes: Watch Student Involvement announcements in fall, plan semi-formal attire and attend this President-hosted welcome to the academic year.
cards.short_summary: A fall-semester, semi-formal campus gathering hosted by the University president.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart identifies the President's Gala as a fall-semester tradition hosted by President Petillo to welcome the academic year.
cards.access_notes: Held each fall semester; verify the current invitation, date and attendance details with Student Involvement.

cards.title: Bring your people to Family Weekend
cards.subtitle: Sacred Heart University, Fairfield, CT
cards.notes: Coordinate with family or supporters, then use the University’s current program to select campus events and time to explore the local area.
cards.short_summary: A recurring weekend that brings Pioneer families onto campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart says Family Weekend brings Pioneer families together to spend time on campus, attend events and explore the local area.
cards.access_notes: Check the University’s current Family Weekend schedule and any registration requirements before making plans.

cards.title: Mark the season at Fall Fest
cards.subtitle: Sacred Heart University, Fairfield, CT
cards.notes: Look for the Student Events Team’s annual fall program, then pick from its changing mix of food trucks, inflatables, crafts and giveaways.
cards.short_summary: A Student Events Team fall kickoff whose theme changes each year.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart states that its Student Events Team holds Fall Fest annually and varies the theme, with food trucks, inflatables, make-and-takes and giveaways.
cards.access_notes: Annual event; the theme, activities and attendance details vary, so confirm the current Student Events Team listing.

cards.title: Catch the spring Pioneer Nation concert
cards.subtitle: Sacred Heart University, Fairfield, CT
cards.notes: Follow Student Involvement announcements in spring for the artist, entry process and event rules for this current-student concert tradition.
cards.short_summary: A one-night spring concert presented on campus for current students.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart describes Pioneer Nation as a one-night spring concert on campus open only to its current students.
cards.access_notes: Current Sacred Heart students only; confirm artist, entry requirements and accessibility information when the event is announced.

cards.title: Celebrate campus work at the CLLAs
cards.subtitle: Sacred Heart University, Fairfield, CT
cards.notes: Check the current Campus Life Leadership Awards information to nominate, attend or recognize students whose work has benefited campus and community.
cards.short_summary: An awards tradition recognizing student contributions across campus and the wider community.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart says the Campus Life Leadership Awards celebrate student contributions across campus and within the greater community.
cards.access_notes: See the current Campus Life Leadership Awards page for nomination, attendance and event information.

cards.title: Close the semester at Spring Fest Carnival
cards.subtitle: Sacred Heart University, Fairfield, CT
cards.notes: Save the final spring-semester weekend, then review the Student Events Team program for rides, games and food offered at the campus carnival.
cards.short_summary: An end-of-semester carnival staged with the Student Events Team.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart says the Spring Fest Carnival is held during the last weekend of the spring semester to wrap up the school year.
cards.access_notes: Held during the last weekend of the spring semester; confirm the current program and any participation details.

cards.title: Make time for Senior Week
cards.subtitle: Sacred Heart University, Fairfield, CT
cards.notes: As graduation approaches, follow senior-class communications for the current schedule and choose events that help you reflect with your class.
cards.short_summary: A pre-graduation tradition for seniors to gather and share their Sacred Heart memories.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart describes Senior Week as a final opportunity for graduating seniors to come together, share memories and celebrate their time at the University.
cards.access_notes: For graduating seniors; obtain the current schedule and participation details from University communications.

cards.title: Set out a blanket for Mass on the Grass
cards.subtitle: Chapel Quad, Sacred Heart University, Fairfield, CT
cards.notes: Bring a blanket and gather on the Chapel Quad for the first Mass of the semester; afterward, connect with Campus Ministry and student leaders.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor Chapel Quad Mass that opens the semester’s worship calendar.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart’s Welcome Weekend schedule calls Mass on the Grass one of SHU’s favorite traditions and places the first Mass of the semester on the Chapel Quad.
cards.source_title: Welcome Weekend Schedule | Sacred Heart University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor Chapel Quad event; check the current Welcome Weekend schedule for timing and weather-related updates.

cards.title: Begin at Welcome Weekend
cards.subtitle: Sacred Heart University, Fairfield, CT
cards.notes: Use the official Welcome Weekend schedule to navigate move-in, academic sessions and social events before classes begin, including the class picture.
cards.short_summary: The University’s multi-day beginning-of-year welcome for new students.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart says Welcome Weekend begins students’ SHU journey with move-in, academic sessions and social events, and lists the class picture and First 50 Days Kickoff as signature events.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists Welcome Weekend for August 27–30, 2026; residential and commuter participation details are provided there.
